data.body: Root cause confirmed (2026-11-03, host load average ~30). review_plan_start does 5 git child processes before returning the handle, all for the dedup key: ensure_fresh rev-parse + throttled fetch (material read), resolve_basis_sha rev-parse, canonical_ticket_id tracker_dir rev-parse. Index write and daemon spawn cost under 5 ms. Deterministic repro: a PATH shim that sleeps 0.45 s before real git made the unchanged test fail at line 424 with 'assert 2.478... < 2' while the stub gate was still held. Classification: the bound measured host subprocess cost, not the contract; no production change. Fix: ordering oracle (_start_review_plan_and_check_gate) plus inline-spawn mutant test. Results: module 29 passed; rewritten test passes with git slowed 0.45 s and 1.0 s; with _spawn_gate_daemon patched in source to run _bg() inline, the rewritten test fails at the ordering assertion ('assert not True'). MCP gate modules 57 passed; make lint and make typecheck exit 0. Adjacent observation, not filed: the start's material read runs ensure_fresh, so the first start per minute per tracker includes a git fetch before the handle; its production duration is unmeasured.
